description: 18650 lithium-ion cell sold as Panasonic NCR18650B with solder tabs; the listing brand is "Generica / compatible", so authenticity is not confirmed

unit.capacity_src: capacity.nominal-at-25c-typical — a nota do components.json manda usar o valor de datasheet como figura de projeto, não os 3450 mAh anunciados pelo vendedor

ports.label: + / - (descarga)
ports.note: a corrente contínua máxima NÃO consta na folha da Panasonic (as curvas vão até 2C, ~6,7 A). Os 10 A do vendedor não podem ser usados para dimensionar

ports.label: + / - (carga)
ports.note: CC-CV, corte em 65 mA; sem circuito de proteção — o pack precisa de BMS e carregador próprios

capacity.note: mAh; the seller advertises 3450 mAh, above the 3350 mAh typical of the genuine datasheet - treat the datasheet value as the design figure

charging.note: current in mA, time in hours

discharge.note: amperes; the Panasonic specification sheet does not state a maximum continuous discharge current (its curves go up to 2C, about 6.7 A); the 10 A claimed by the seller is not backed by any datasheet and must not be used for sizing

specs.note: no protection circuit and no BMS included; a pack built from these cells needs protection, balancing and a charger
